items.title: Introducing ChatGPT
items.summary: We’ve trained a model called ChatGPT which interacts in a conversational way. The dialogue format makes it possible for ChatGPT to answer followup questions, admit its mistakes, challenge incorrect premises, and reject inappropriate requests.
items.summaryZh: OpenAI官方宣布推出名为ChatGPT的全新对话式大模型。该模型采用创新的对话格式进行训练，不仅能够流畅地回答用户的后续追问，还具备主动承认错误、质疑错误前提以及拒绝不当请求的核心能力，开启了生成式AI走向大众普及与实际落地的全新阶段。
